description: Fan-out heterogeneous refute-first audit squad, union-merge findings into blocker register, iterate until HIGH+CRITICAL count converges.

steps.label: fanout-audit
steps.note: Dispatch all three profiles in parallel against the same artifact. Each runner must be a different model family from the artifact producer.

steps.label: union-merge
steps.action: union-merge findings from all runners into blocker-register-round-N.json
steps.note: Do NOT deduplicate or vote. Every finding from every runner enters the register. Identical claims may appear multiple times; that is intentional signal.

steps.label: host-triage
steps.action: host reads each blocker, verifies cited path:line evidence, classifies adopt/reject/needs-info
steps.note: LLM claim alone is not evidence. Host must open and read the cited file location. Rejected blockers require a falsification note.

steps.label: convergence-check
steps.check: HIGH+CRITICAL count in triage <= previous round AND zero new HIGH/CRITICAL blockers in this round
steps.on_not_converged: apply adopted fixes, increment N, return to step 1
steps.note: Two consecutive clean rounds required before declaring convergence. If count is non-monotonic (rebounds), pause and re-examine audit scope or artifact.

stop_conditions: HIGH+CRITICAL blocker count monotonically non-increasing across all rounds
two consecutive rounds with zero new HIGH/CRITICAL blockers
every adopted/rejected blocker has first-hand evidence (path:line or command output)
anti_patterns: ap1:same-family self-audit — auditor and producer share model family
ap2:vote-to-merge-findings — majority vote used instead of union merge
ap3:historical-contrast hallucination — before/after context shown to auditor
ap4:rubber-stamp PASS — empty findings accepted without proof-of-read
